title: Panel snapshot/regression tests for StoryBiblePanel, Sidebar, AppMainContent
description: Add snapshot tests (or update existing ones) for the standardized panel layouts in StoryBiblePanel.test.tsx, Sidebar.test.tsx, and AppMainContent.test.tsx. Capture renders at 1280px viewport width to lock in the normalized spacing and heading classes from TASK-004 and TASK-005.
action: In StoryBiblePanel.test.tsx, Sidebar.test.tsx, AppMainContent.test.tsx: add or update snapshot tests using toMatchSnapshot(). If existing snapshots exist, delete .snap files and let tests regenerate them with the new normalized classes. Add at least one 'renders without errors' and one 'matches snapshot' test per file.

convergence.definition_of_done: Snapshot tests pass and capture the normalized panel layouts. Any stale snapshots are regenerated.

files.change: Add snapshot test: render <StoryBiblePanel /> with minimal mocks, expect container.firstChild toMatchSnapshot()
Add snapshot test for Sidebar at collapsed=false state
Add or update snapshot test for main content layout

implementation: Step 1 — Read each test file to understand current test setup and what mocks are already in place.
Step 2 — If __snapshots__/*.snap files exist for these components, delete them so they regenerate with post-TASK-004/005 classes.
Step 3 — In StoryBiblePanel.test.tsx: add 'it("matches snapshot", () => { const { container } = render(<StoryBiblePanel ...minimalProps />); expect(container.firstChild).toMatchSnapshot() })'.
Step 4 — Repeat for Sidebar.test.tsx with collapsed=false props.
Step 5 — For AppMainContent.test.tsx: add a smoke-render test if not present.
Step 6 — Run pnpm test -- --run for these three files. Snapshots will be generated on first run.
Step 7 — Commit the generated .snap files alongside the test changes.

success_metrics: All three test files pass, .snap files generated

reference.pattern: Existing snapshot tests in the codebase (check for any *.test.tsx with toMatchSnapshot)

rationale.chosen_approach: Snapshot tests as regression guards after layout normalization — cheap to add, catches accidental class regressions in future.
decision_factors: Roadmap TASK-1.12 explicitly requests snapshot tests
rationale.tradeoffs: Snapshots can be brittle with frequent UI changes — but Phase 1 layout is intended to be stable.

risks: StoryBiblePanel may require complex store mocking — check existing test setup and replicate the minimal mock pattern.
